in_sanskrit.name: Raheman
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Protector, Guardian, God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Raheman एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Raheman is a Hindu name that means 'Protector, Guardian, God'. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'Rahman' which means 'Most Gracious, Most Merciful, Benevolent'. In Hinduism, this name is associated with the deity Rahu, the North Node of the Moon, which is considered a protector and guardian in astrology. Raheman is a powerful name that evokes a sense of protection, strength, and divine grace.
